PASS on the fake backend (evidence contract_checked; never an MHS-Device level). Served device mhs://localhost/fruitfly, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R0 (the card's floor and the R0 floors of cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1). The card's models[0], src/flygym/assets/model/flybody/fruitfly.xml, is read in place from the read-only clone at 38c8ec61034cd59bc5ba0de20688d4a3c0000d60; nothing is copied, imported, installed or modified. The card's entry symbol flygym_demo.muscle_imitation.env:ImitationEnv was confirmed at src/flygym_demo/muscle_imitation/env.py:83; it is a Gymnasium wrapper that needs a pre-built flygym.Simulation, gymnasium, numpy and the upstream package, so this package keeps the card's family-config/MujocoDriver shape and serves models[0] as PLAYBOOK.md section 8 directs for MuJoCo cards. The served model has a free joint on the thorax (7 qpos, 6 qvel), 102 hinge joints (109 qpos, 108 qvel), 78 actuators (70 general and 8 adhesion) and a 0.0001 s step; the bridge derives action.ctrl per actuator from actuator_ctrlrange, and the package declares no Limit of its own, so no site-limits.example.json is needed. The fake backend (fake.py) is the package's stand-in for the mujoco library (a factory callable, not a class), which parses the same MJCF for the joint coordinates, ctrlranges and step and integrates a placeholder first-order motion; it is not MuJoCo and computes no mesh, contact, adhesion, exclusion, tendon, equality, inertia or actuator dynamics. MuJoCo itself was not installed and was never run. Warnings: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the MuJoCo fake is a stand-in module factory, so the gate cannot record or compare a native class surface and describes it as an upstream simulator; the bridge-boundary checks still pass) and G8.NO_UNIT x3 (ticks, action.ctrl[*] and the reset seed, expected for a simulated world per PLAYBOOK.md section 8). G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo engine; the card's ImitationEnv/Gymnasium interface and the musculoskeletal model (models[1]); the model's 15 sensors, nine cameras and 85 mesh references; adhesion, contact, exclusion, tendon and equality constraints; snapshot/restore beyond the stand-in's own deterministic state; and any physical fly (no hardware run is claimed). The package is model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is the model/run id and reviewed_by is null.
